description: Boundary coverage for encrypted session round-trip: a 16-byte and a 24-byte secret (other accepted AES key sizes) round-trip every field; an empty refresh token round-trips as empty while the access token recovers; a session with a zero/epoch expiry and one with a far-future expiry both recover the clear expiry exactly; decoding with a different same-length secret recovers the clear fields but not the encrypted tokens.
